description: We provide a graph-powered infrastructure for programmatic access to an interconnected legal corpus of EU, Italian and Regional legislation and jurisprudence with precise temporal versioning. We empower agents integrating advanced semantic search, linguistic analytics, and real-time legislative monitoring into high-precision legal-tech and research applications.
